verdict.rationale: Plugging MCP servers into a product so it can use their tools is a client-side role that only makes sense for products that run an AI agent or assistant. The Texas Comptroller is a government tax filing, payment and open-data portal (Webfile, eSystems, Socrata datasets), so this is the wrong axis. Nothing in the evidence shows the portal hosts an agent that could consume MCP tools.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
